feed.title: Bounds Ledger: constant 24a, changes to its pinned bound rows
feed.subtitle: One entry for each change this ledger saw in the bound cell of a pinned row, as this ledger's extractor reads it, comparing each pinned version with the one before it on this ledger's main line. A pin's first appearance, an edit that leaves the bound cell byte for byte the same, and a version in which the pin is missing produce no entry. An entry identifies the constant, the side and the date of this ledger's commit, without quoting the bound cell, and never says what the bound is or whether it moved: a pin selects a row by its listing position in upstream's table, and that position alone says nothing about the bound's strength. The constant's page shows the current pinned rows; the linked commit shows the recorded edit.

entry.title: 24a upper bound: pinned bound cell changed 2026-10-26
entry.content:
This ledger's pinned copy of the upper-bound row of constant 24a, as this ledger's extractor reads it from teorth/optimizationproblems, changed in its bound cell in a commit dated 2026-10-26.
This feed does not say what the bound cell holds now, what changed in it, or whether the bound moved. Upstream's tables can keep superseded and weaker rows. A pin selects a row by its listing position, and that position alone says nothing about the bound's strength.
Read this constant's page and its source file before citing: https://u00dxk2.github.io/bounds-ledger/c/24a.html
The date is the one on this ledger's commit; upstream's own change can be earlier, several upstream edits can fall between two of this ledger's versions and arrive as one entry, and an edit made and undone between them leaves no entry. That commit: https://github.com/u00dxk2/bounds-ledger/commit/f85e829e91f674fbf5b0c15fb5077f385b43b075
